order: Change the guard's default behavior for an undetermined model from enforcing to standing down. Base enforcement on positive evidence of a director model in the transcript, rather than falling back to enforcing simply because the model is undetermined at the moment of the check. A brand-new session's first turn — before any assistant entry is flushed into the transcript — sees no denial, and neither does an ordinary, non-director session at any later turn of its own. A genuine director session absorbs exactly one unenforced opening turn, with hard enforcement engaging the instant the model reaches the transcript and not a moment later. The existing delegation instructions already cover that single gap, so no further compensating change belongs anywhere else. Update only the docs describing mode detection and troubleshooting to match the corrected default, and keep every other guard behavior unchanged.
claims: The guard now requires positive evidence of a director model before enforcing; sessions without one — including a fresh session's first turn — never see a denial. A genuine director session absorbs exactly one unenforced opening turn before hard enforcement engages the instant the model reaches the transcript, which the existing delegation instructions already cover. Docs on mode detection and troubleshooting were brought in line with it, confined to three files with no other line touched.
